description: Defines the enumeration AmortizationMethod which specifies different amortization strategies (equal principal, equal installments, invalid) used in loan products. Includes methods for retrieving values, conversion from integer, and checking specific methods.

classes.name: AmortizationMethod
classes.description: Enumeration representing various amortization methods with associated behaviors and properties.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the amortization method.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the amortization method.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding AmortizationMethod enum value, defaulting to INVALID for unrecognized inputs.

methods.name: isEqualInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the current method is EQUAL_INSTALLMENTS.

methods.name: isEqualPrincipal
methods.description: Checks if the current method is EQUAL_PRINCIPAL.
